title: Saving Legal Cannabis Isn’t the Win We Think It Is
excerpt: Massachusetts will almost certainly reject Question 8, which would end recreational sales. As a public health researcher who lives here, I think it should be a wake-up call anyway.

title: How Many Surveys Does Allston-Brighton Need to Get a Community Center on the Books?
excerpt: Four years and at least nine asks later, the city still hasn't decided what to build at Jackson Mann.

title: Who Pays for the Care Insurance Won't?
excerpt: At CHOP, for about 1,200 families a year, the answer is one family from Pottstown and the food festival they built in their daughter's name.

title: 39,182 Deaths, Out of How Many?
excerpt: Somebody carried a poster of raw adverse event counts into the Fauci hearing this week. I spent an afternoon trying to find the denominators it left out, and six of its seven rows don't have one.

title: They Bought the Building for $655K. They Now Owe $5 Million.
excerpt: The value left as cash, while the debt stayed with the building and the tenants inside it. What I learned isn't a story about one bad landlord. It's about the system that rewards it.

title: The Test Strip Said Negative
excerpt: Kai Raydon did everything right and died anyway, from a drug too new for any test to catch. That isn't bad luck. It's what prohibition produces.
